author: Robin_DD_J
body:
Hello,

At the moment Avicus need money, we need money to get developers that are willing to fix major issues on the server. At the moment, I havn't seen any big progress. But that may change.

Anyways,
You should be able to buy unbans, up to a maxium of 3 times.
  • First unban bought would cost 3$
  • Second unban bought would cost 7$
  • Third unban bought would cost 12$
I'd like this added because Avicus needs money to make progress on their gameplay and website. We need more development. It would also give a fair price for people who was banned for a fair reason to come back on and play.
Player: But what if the person just come backs on and hack???
Well, what a shame for them, the next unban only comes up in price and Avicus will make more money out of it. And to be fair, it doesn't take a lot of effort to just type in a single ban command if the player now is hacking.
Player: But it would be unfair because some people have money and some don't.
Well, that's just silly. It's the exacly same thing as saying "It's not fair to have ranks because some people dont have money to buy them".

-------------

Now this,
I'd like something called an "infraction cleaner". It basically cleans ur infractions. A player would only be able to buy this if he stays clean for atleast 4 months. People who feel embarressd, or are scared of having a ban for exsessive infractions just because they get 1 more warn would use this very well.
 
  • Instead of cleaning all infractions for a certain price, you could choose how many infractions you'd like to remove. One infraction would cost 0.5$ and then it just keeps on adding up. People with a lot of infractions would have to pay more if they want to come all clean.
Well, that's basically it. I mainly want these things to get some more money to avicus so we can imrpove the development.
I will also add these "Player" comment on the infraction cleaner if anyone gets an idea to arguement with me ;)
I'd also like to put these two posts who gave me ideas and stuff, I just think they didn't explain the ideas very good.
https://avicus.net/forums/9d25cdb63
https://avicus.net/forums/b0b323c8e

PLEASE TAKE UR TIME AND READ EVERYTHING

Thank you.

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
I'm fine with the payable unbans but the infraction cleaner isn't a smart thing to implement.
An infraction list is a good indicator for staff to use when punishing people (espiecally repeat offenders).

If these people clear their infractions after 4 months, how will we know that they've had a history of breaking the rules? 

All infractions need to be readily available for staff to use.
